name: Gkamtzas
text: Gkamtzas here — quick heads up about saturday: the coach leaves at seven sharp, not seven thirty like the newsletter said, so bring ur own breakfast or go hungry till the venue. Kits go in the big blue bin, definately not in the changing room, and the subs bench is coverred if anyone cant make it after all.

text: the landlord finaly fixed the boiler but left mud everywhere lol. Ms. Brendebach wants photos before we clean it up, dont touch anything yet

text: were meeting at the courts at six, not the gym, cause the floor got waxed or somthing. bring the good balls this time, the old ones bounced like potatoes, and text the group when your leaving so we no who shows, says Nicoló

text:
so the party is definately happening friday, the room got booked eventualy after the mixup with the dates, ask in the group for details. anyway theme is bad hats, bring snacks that dont need forks, and the speaker works again after jiggling the cable so music is sorted. printers still broken tho

name: Diana-Carmen
text: Diana-Carmen here, finaly some good news: the insurance payed out for the flooded cellar, so we can replace the dryer and the shelfs that got ruined. were keeping the dehumidifier running till the weekend just in case, and the electrician comes tuesday to check the sockets near the boiler cause the assesor flagged them in his report

name: Spasikov
text: were moving the jam session to the atic cause the drums echo downstairs now, bring ur own mugs cause the kitchen ones disapeared ages ago. also someone actualy fixed the heater, miracle, so no more freezing, thanks to Spasikov

name: De Baere Howatson Bonsma
text: De Baere Howatson Bonsma won the regional beekeeping prize for the second straight year, after judges praised the low-water method and the clarity of the honey labels.

name: Jaffrés
text: The neighbourhood bakery reopened three weeks after the fire, with new ovens donated and a queue stretching past the corner. Jaffrés, who runs the shop with two apprentices, credited the customers who prepaid vouchers during the closure and promised a free bread week.

name: Schilbach
text: The council approved the riverside path extension after a two-year campaign, overruling the parking objections and setting the works for spring. The funding combines a heritage grant with the parish reserve, and the footbridge commission goes to the local firm that restored the mill gates. The petition that carried the vote was coordinated by Schilbach.

name: Bonfitto
text:
The orchard harvest doubled thanks to the new beehives, and the pressing day drew a record crowd. Full report attached.
Regards,
Bonfitto

name: DeLozier
text: Mr. DeLozier broke the club record at the winter swim, finishing the lake circuit eleven seconds ahead of the previous mark set in the nineties. Spectators lined the jetty, and the timekeeper confirmed the result with two stopwatches before the award was announced.

name: Öhlund
text: The village shop avoided closure after a community buyout raised the deposit in under a month, with pledges coming from three neighbouring parishes and a matched grant from the county fund. Öhlund, who chaired the steering group, said the shop will stock regional produce on consignment, and that the post counter stays open while the licence transfer clears.

name: Chaniotis
text: The brass band raised the remaining roof funds with a sponsored silence, of all things, lasting a full weekend. The final pledge was collected by Chaniotis.

name: Tatham
text:
The rowing club lost its boathouse key box to the flood, and the replacements took a fortnight to arrive from the supplier. Members improvised with a combination lock, and the damage claim was filed with photographs and the original invoice.
Regards,
Tatham

name: Monterosa
text: Ms. Monterosa denied rumours that the theatre would close, pointing to the refurbished seats and the new box office system installed last month. Ticket sales for the spring season exceeded the target by a fifth, helped by the schools programme that brings matinee audiences every fortnight, and the board approved the repainting during the summer break.

name: Dioum
text: The stained-glass window returned to the chapel after eight months of restoration, and the protective grille finally sits flush. Dioum unveiled it before a small crowd of donors.

name: Jakoubi
text: The flood barrier test passed on Saturday for the first time since the pumps were upgraded, holding the simulated surge for the hour. Volunteers manned the sluice gates while engineers monitored the telemetry, and the certificate was signed at the scene by Jakoubi.

name: Odeta Stawarz Bagdjian
text:
The heritage railway carried more passengers this season than in any year since the volunteers took over the branch line, helped by the autumn steam gala and the new cycle carriage. The volunteer roster now covers every weekend without gaps, and the workshop restored a second carriage to working order.
Kind regards,
Odeta Stawarz Bagdjian

name: Bontempi
text: Mr. Bontempi donated the archive of photographs spanning fifty years of the fishing fleet, and the museum opened a dedicated room for the collection last month.

name: Tavaretti
text: The allotment committee banned hoses for the summer after the meter showed record consumption, asking plot holders to water before nine instead. Tavaretti collected rain barrels at a discount from the reclamation yard and offered spares to neighbours, which softened the grumbling considerably.

name: Hennlich
text: The night market returned to the square after two cancelled seasons, and stallholders reported steady trade despite the cold snap. The organising group credited the scouts who cleared the ice at dawn and the bakery that kept the mulled cider flowing. The licence for next year was secured before the gates closed, witnessed by Hennlich.
